sources.quote: Can Meccanica Chisone take over the BR-225 blanks?
SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks
Status: rejected on 2026-10-02 by A. Conti

findings.why: No controlled approval record covers SUP-C for BR-225 for any receiving plant or customer. The supplier master only lists the commodity. DEV-127 (rejected) concerns BR-220, and DEV-114 (expired) concerns BR-180, so neither covers BR-225. The customer of BR-225 is not stated in any document. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether SUP-C is released for BR-225.
